title: PLLuM: A Family of Polish Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Comparative human evaluation (LLM Arena) and expert domain assessment of Polish Matura exam essays to detect English-centric language transfer (e.g., unnatural phrasing, English formatting artifacts) and evaluate the inclusion of local Polish cultural and literary references.

bias_targets.target: Sociodemographic bias (Race, Gender, Age, Religion, Sexual Orientation)
bias_targets.methodology: Human annotator and LLM-as-a-judge evaluations of model responses using a scalar 'Fairness' dimension to check for neutrality, inclusivity, and the absence of stereotypes, alongside safety guidelines explicitly penalizing discrimination based on personal characteristics.
